pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment: Grinding of Carica papayas (Pawpaw) peels into ≤20 mm mesh sizes using a hammer mill.

Thermo-alkaline pretreatment: 60 min thermal treatment at 80 °C using the CLIFTON 88579 water bath followed by chemical pretreatment using 3 g NaOH for 100 g TS at 55° C for 24 h and a solid loading of 35 g TS/L.
